warning.titlePre: Mercedes SL500/SL550 V8 Valve Seal & Coolant Wear
paragraphs: SL500/SL550 engines — M113, M273 and M278, across every SL generation — commonly show valve seal and coolant system wear at higher mileage. This is a well-documented pattern on these V8s, confirmed by established Mercedes specialist sources. We replace valve seals, coolant system components, timing chain components and bearings as standard on every rebuild.
Source: established Mercedes specialist pattern, per VRF-mercedes-sl.md. Applies to M113, M273 and M278 across all generations.
